# Core Bins, bin pop-up (census #51 Move C2, #52 Load C3) and Create bin's label check.
# static/pages/bins.js run as served over PAGE_NODES / PAGE_PAYLOADS = the fixture.
# (The Create bin Node select itself is server-rendered: bins-template.txt.)

== Move destination (C2): renderActions, bin at GRP-A-L1-S1
  "" | -- Select --
  "1" | GRP-A
  "2" | GRP-A-L1
  "4" | GRP-A-L1-S2
  "5" | GRP-B
  "6" | GRP-B-N1
  "7" | GRP-B-N2
  "8" | LINE-1
  "9" | SPOT-9
  "12" | OLD-SLOT
  "13" | VIRT-1
  "14" | GRP-OFF
  "15" | GRP-OFF-N1
  dropped: the bin's own node, _TRANSIT, _ROBOT:*; kept: groups, lanes, the disabled OLD-SLOT
  and GRP-OFF, VIRT-1. No headings, no badges, value = id, label = name (not display name).
  an unassigned bin: 13 destinations, GRP-A-L1-S1 included

== Load payload (C3): renderContents, per bin type (PAGE_PAYLOAD_BIN_TYPES filters)
  bin type 1: "", "PART-A", "PART-C"
  bin type 2: "", "PART-B", "PART-A"
  bin type 3: "", "PART-A"
  held (load_refusal set): select disabled, sentence shown: true, Load button disabled
  (no request)

== the body each pick sends (an answer of 200)
-- Move to LINE-1
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"move","params":{"node_id":8}}
-- Move, nothing picked
  (no request)
  toast info: Select a destination
-- Move to where it is
  (no request)
  toast info: Bin is already at this location
-- Request Move to GRP-B-N1 (the detail re-reads never answer here)
  POST /api/bins/request-move {"bin_id":50,"destination_node_id":6}
  GET /api/bins/detail?id=50&history=0
  GET /api/bins/detail?id=50&history=0
  toast info: Move #41 to GRP-B-N1 requested (queued): the lane is busy
-- Load PART-A, count blank
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"load_payload","params":{"payload_code":"PART-A"}}
-- Load PART-A, count 0
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"load_payload","params":{"payload_code":"PART-A","uop_override":0}}
-- Load, nothing picked
  (no request)
  toast info: Select a payload

== refusals: Move to LINE-1
-- json.400: 400 "{\"error\":\"refused: the service's sentence\"}"
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"move","params":{"node_id":8}}
  toast error: Error: refused: the service's sentence
-- auth.401: 401 "{\"error\":\"unauthorized\"}"
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"move","params":{"node_id":8}}
  toast error: Error: unauthorized
-- json.500: 500 "{\"error\":\"failed: the store's error\"}"
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"move","params":{"node_id":8}}
  toast error: Error: failed: the store's error
-- proxy.502: 502 "<html><body>502 Bad Gateway</body></html>"
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"move","params":{"node_id":8}}
  toast error: Error: <html><body>502 Bad Gateway</body></html>
-- fetch rejects (TypeError: Failed to fetch)
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"move","params":{"node_id":8}}
  toast error: Error: TypeError: Failed to fetch

== refusals: Request Move to GRP-B-N1
-- json.409: 409 "{\"error\":\"refused: the service's sentence\"}"
  POST /api/bins/request-move {"bin_id":50,"destination_node_id":6}
  toast error: Error: refused: the service's sentence
-- fetch rejects (TypeError: Failed to fetch)
  POST /api/bins/request-move {"bin_id":50,"destination_node_id":6}
  toast error: Error: TypeError: Failed to fetch

== Create bin: confirmBinCreate, the label checked against PAGE_NODES (every node)
-- label "LINE-1" x1: checked as ["LINE-1"]; default prevented 1, form.submit() x0
  (no request)
  toast error: Label LINE-1 is already a NODE name — carriers and nodes cannot share labels. Fix the label prefix.
-- label "OLD-SLOT" x1: checked as ["OLD-SLOT0001"]; default prevented 1, form.submit() x1
  (no request)
-- label "_TRANSIT" x1: checked as ["_TRANSIT0001"]; default prevented 1, form.submit() x1
  (no request)
-- label "GRP-A" x1: checked as ["GRP-A0001"]; default prevented 1, form.submit() x1
  (no request)
-- label "CART-7" x1: checked as ["CART-7"]; default prevented 1, form.submit() x1
  (no request)
-- label "CART-" x3: checked as ["CART-0001","CART-0002","CART-0003"]; default prevented 1, form.submit() x1
  (no request)
  confirm: "Create 3 carriers labeled CART-0001 … CART-0003?"
Pinned as is: batchLabelsPreview appends 0001 to a single label with no trailing number, where the
server's batchLabels (service/bin_service.go) keeps it as typed; so a single carrier named exactly
like OLD-SLOT, _TRANSIT or GRP-A passes the node-name check, and the preview names a label never made.
